brief: We want annual support costs at most £210,000. Compare retaining the internal team with outsourcing first-line support. We currently spend £245,000 per year. Extra support tickets increase support workload; extra workload increases support costs. Outsourcing may introduce service-quality problems, but their effect on costs is unknown.
